newsitem.title: USA: First Charter may acquire Carolina.
newsitem.headline: First Charter may acquire Carolina.

text.p: First Charter Corp said Monday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Carolina State Bank in a deal giving 1.023 common shares of First Charter for each Carolina State common share.
Based on First Charter's Friday stock price of $21.75 per share, the value of the deal equals $38.3 million, or $22.25 for each share of Carolina State Bank Common Stock.
The deal would create a banking company with combined assets of about $700 million and serving the Charlotte area of North Carolina.
First Charter shares closed down 2-1/2 Monday at 21-3/4. Those of Carolina State were unchanged at 13-1/4.
The companies said in a joint statement Monday that the deal would be structured as a tax-free reorganization and would be accounted for as a pooling of interests.
As part of the pact, Carolina State Bank has granted First Charter the option to buy up to 19.9 percent of its outstanding common stock, under certain circumstances.
They said the pact still requires a definitive agreement and regulatory and shareholder approvals.
